## Summary

**STOREM3** (Store gfx-masked register into memory): Store bytes from b into destination, depending on mode.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `b → <vea> depending on mode.` |
| Syntax | `STOREM3 b,#mode,<vea>`<br>Where the &lt;vea&gt; content is used as mask to write or not. |
| Short | Store bytes from b into destination, depending on mode |
| Description | Specialized memory write to perform fast graphical cookie cut. Storem3 is a conditional write of 8 bytes. The selection depends on the source and mask\_mode. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | `0` |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d (mask\_mode) |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00100110` |

- mask\_mode: writing is done when:
- 0 - Long: 2x 32bit color when msb=1
- 1 - Byte: 8x 8bit color-index when &lt;&gt;0
- 2 - word: 4x Sixteen bit color when color&lt;&gt;$f81f ( = max red & blue = purple)
- 3 - Word: 4x 15bit color when msb=0
- Not allowed &lt;vea&gt; : #imm
- No masking is done when destination is a register.
- bit 11 & 10 second operand are ignored.

### Example

```text
b d0: F8 1F 00 34 12 00 87 65
```

```text
storem3 d0,#0,(a0)     mode L  (a0): F8 1F 00 34 .. .. .. ..
storem3 d0,#1,(a0)     mode B  (a0): F8 1F .. 34 12 .. 87 65
storem3 d0,#2,(a0)     mode S  (a0): .. .. 00 34 12 00 87 65
storem3 d0,#3,(a0)     mode W  (a0): .. .. 00 34 12 00 .. ..
```

### Notes

- Vasm use “storem3 d0,d3,(a0)” (so d3 stands for #3 / Word )
- Asm1 use “storem3 d0,w,(a0)” or vasm
- Debugging with monam shows “storem3 d0,w,(a0)”

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no STOREM3. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T use an immediate `<vea>`.
